answer: An attacker thus cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. The fable schedule is applied in opal and willow reveals each instalment. A payout is split which means 27% arrives at settlement and the rest over 20 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 3415 identities would post 1450 proofs and burn roughly 4 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
